literal_statement_repair_policy: The printed Krein normalization and claimed positive/negative subspaces require independent review. A corrected identity or cone must remain labelled corrected; the literal target is not assumed.
coverage: Encodes the actual signed density, mode density, and normalized affine pencil on finite rational coefficient data. Existing finite spectral algebra is imported. The analytic axioms only support justified interchanges.
remaining: Discharge kernel/summability bounds, identify generalized moments and the exact signed formula including its constants, and prove real roots from independent coefficients. Infinite signed-subspace existence is a separate open problem; no implication from mode independence is assumed. Establish highest-weight p-adic leading blocks before determinant valuation.
